evidence: The Hump Ridge Great Walk begins at Rarakau car park.
The Hump Ridge Track starts from the Rarakau car park near Tuatapere in southern Fiordland.
The track leads around the edge of Te Waewae Bay and back to Rarakau car park.

doubts: The walk is a loop: it goes from Rarakau car park along the South Coast Track to the Hump Ridge Track, over the lodges, and back along the South Coast Track to the car park. No direction is given. Rarakau car park is taken as F1 (where South Coast Track meets Papatotara Coast Road), the only road-end feature in the packet; the text does not name the road. The fords are recorded where the text says the route crosses the river or stream; the text does not say whether a bridge is there, so those are a judgement. Ōkaka Lodge and Port Craig Lodge have no link and no lodge entry, so their refs are null. Ōkākā ridge (T13) is not used for the lodge. The Blow Holes Beach high tide track is an alternative during tidal surges, not a way of the walk. The Percy Burn viaduct is taken as the road end feature F2, which the packet names for that viaduct.
